output.objection: You are treating my lack of a registry as a gap in my workflow, but it is a deliberate choice to keep training cycles fast. I need you to acknowledge that I am trading reproducibility for speed because the current setup forces that trade off.
output.correction: I am not asking for a manual logging process to be added to my daily routine. I am saying that if you want reproduction, you must accept that I will log details manually only when the run is critical, not every single time.
